syllabus_topics: Functioning of the body in movement (professional and leisure/sport world)
Review of the principles of human body functioning (cardio-respiratory, neurological), anatomy (arthrology, myology) and effort physiology
Fundamentals of biomechanics and human movement analysis (planes, axes and movements, anthropometry, ergonomics)
Fundamental principles of mechanics applied to the expression of force, flexibility and resistance of the muscular and osteo-tendinous system
Dietetics-nutrition to optimize human movement (daily or sport)
Effects of professional stress (physical and psychological)
institution: Ecole Nationale Superieure De Mecanique Et Des Microtechnique
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur ENSMM (cycle ingénieur, spécialité Mécanique) — 1.er y 2.º año
